wiki.title: Counselor Kaela
wiki.text:
Counselor Kaela is a pixie NPC that can be found in the perimeters of Camp Chatty, located in the Greenwood Forest.

She is also an enemy NPC in Bigfoot Defender. She is with Jake, Edmond, and Tyra to find and hurt Bigfoot.
